## Summary

Provide a short summary of the change and the problem it fixes (1-2 sentences).

## Why

Explain the motivation for this change and any user need it addresses.

## What

Describe the approach and important decisions — focus on the why and the approach, not a file list.

## How to test

List steps to verify the change locally (commands, environment variables, quick smoke tests). If not applicable write "N/A".

## Checklist

- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] I have added necessary documentation (where applicable)
- [ ] I have run the project tests and they pass locally
- [ ] This PR follows the repository's code style and contribution guidelines

## Notes for reviewers

Add any context reviewers should know (trade-offs, risks, special review areas). If nothing to call out, write "N/A".
